# Speak\_ careers

Speak\_ is a customizable AI recruitment partner that reviews every resume to help you find the right candidates more efficiently. It evaluates applicants asynchronously, saving you hours of sifting through unsorted resumes to identify the best ones. Speak\_ uses applications to assess each candidate based on specific criteria, ensuring that only the top applicants.
